metadata.summary: This section contains the Proceedings for each of the annual IGF meetings held since 2006. Each of the Proceedings reflects the meeting programme, content and format, and serves as the primary document of record for that meeting. Below are the Proceedings, presented by year, venue and main theme of the meeting.

IGF Brochures & Select Publications
This section contains recent
IGF
brochures and selected publications.
IGF Achievements and Impact
2005-2025 Brochure
As the Internet Governance Forum (
IGF
) marks twenty years since its creation, this booklet takes you through the Forum’s journey, impact, and future.
Click here to get the Brochure
.
About the Internet Governance Forum
2025 Brochure
This brochure provides background information and an overview of the
IGF
process, including intersessional work, National and Regional
IGF
initiatives (
NRIs
) and its annual meeting.
Click here to get the Brochure
.
Internet Governance Forum: Introduction to NRIs
National, Sub-regional, Regional and Youth IGF Initiatives (NRIs) Publication
Over the years, the
IGF
has inspired multistakeholder teams from various countries and regions to launch the national and regional
IGF
processes, mirroring the procedures and processes of the
IGF
. These National and Regional Initiatives (
NRIs
) facilitate dialogue and cooperation on Internet policy issues of utmost relevance for their respective communities.
Download short version
|
Download long version
| ​​
See translated versions
IGF Initiatives
A Toolkit to Assist Communities in Establishing the IGF Initiatives
This Toolkit is based on inputs from existing and emerging
IGF
Initiatives, and draws on their
suggestions for information that describes the basic requirements for an
IGF
initiative to be listed on the
IGF
website. It also offers suggestions about organizing structures.
The Toolkit stands as an advisory document and is a result of the
NRIs
collaborative process on establishing basic requirements such as adhering to the
IGF
principles.
Click here to get the Toolkit in
E

.
Newcomer's One-pager
New to the Internet Governance Forum? Start here!
This brochure gives a short introduction to the
IGF
and meant to guide newcomers to participate according to what interest them through
newcomer's page
. It's short and meant to be distributed at
IGF
events to attract newcomers.
Click here to get the Publication
.
Youth Engagement at the IGF: Existing Practices
Youth IGF Initiatives and Other Capacity Development Programmes
This document provides a high-level perspective on some
IGF
youth-focused initiatives, and describes some of the existing practices for incorporating youth into Internet-focused discussions that have developed within the broader
IGF
community
Click here to get the Publication
.
Guide to Key Digital Policy Issues and Related Processes and Organizations
Toolkit for Parliamentarians
This toolkit is intended to provide Members of Parliament (MPs) with an overview of the
IGF
ecosystem and its relevance for parliamentary activities. It also serves to assist MPs navigate several key Internet and digital policy issues as well as related processes and organizations.
Click here to get the Toolkit
.
IGF 2025: Lillestrøm, Norway
Building Digital Governance Together
The
IGF
2025 Report outlines key highlights of the
IGF
2025 process and 20th annual
IGF
meeting. It also contains the thematic messages called Lillestrøm
IGF
Messages.
Click here to get the Report
.
IGF 2024: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Building our Multistakeholder Digital Future
The
IGF
2024 Report outlines key highlights of the
IGF
2024 process and 19th annual
IGF
meeting. It also contains the thematic messages called Riyadh
IGF
Messages.
Click here to get the Report
.
Best Practice Forum on Securing Access to the Internet and Protecting Core Internet Resources in Contexts of Conflict and Crises
2025 BPF on Cybersecurity Report
The Best Practice Forum (
BPF
) is an
IGF
intersessional activity, providing a platform for community driven discussion on Internet policy issues and sharing of experiences. The
IGF
2025
BPF
explores the roles and responsibilities of the multistakeholder Internet community in maintaining civilian access to the Internet and ensuring the protection of the public core of the Internet during times of conflict and crisis.
Click here to get the Report
.
Lessons, Impact on Global AI Governance, and Multistakeholder Vision for 2026 and Beyond
2025 PNAI Report
This report summarizes the activities of the Policy Network on Artificial Intelligence (PNAI) in 2025, highlights key outcomes and presents recommendations. In 2025, the PNAI’s primary objective was to develop actionable recommendations on how the
IGF
can maximize its impact as a central, inclusive and bottom-up multistakeholder platform for AI dialogue.
Click here to get the Report
.
From Knowledge to Implementation: The PNMA's Contribution to WSIS+20 and GDC
2025 PNMA Report
During the 2025 process, the expansion of advocacy and consolidation of the policy network continued. The PNMA offers itself as a benchmark for the implementation of the GDC’s meaningful access objectives. Moreover, its output report continues to be a public portfolio of knowledge and activities that the PNMA can engage in and contribute to the
WSIS
+20 process after the UN renewal and onwards to GDC implementation.
Click here to get the Report
.
Policy Network on Internet Fragmentation
2025 PNIF Report
Based on the discussions in 2025, the PNIF compiled a set of draft recommendations and shared them for community review. The recommendations are intended to inform and support ongoing and future deliberations on the role of the multistakeholder model in preserving an open, free, and global Internet, within the context of the
WSIS
+20 review, the operationalisation of the GDC, and beyond.
Click here to get the Report
.
